Characteristics of Life
–Life is extremely diverse
–How do we begin to categorize things as living or non-living?
–Basic Characteristics (7) shared by all living things
explanation: This slide introduces the characteristics of life. It points out that while life on Earth is extremely diverse, we can categorize entities as living or non-living based on seven basic characteristics shared by all living things.

questions.q: How many basic characteristics are shared by all living things to help categorize them as living or non-living?
questions.exp: The slide states there are 'Basic Characteristics (7) shared by all living things.'
